name: codex-consult
description: Runs `codex exec` as a read-only reviewer from Claude Code and records each consultation as files (brief, verbatim reply, JSON ledger, findings tracked by id), with per-reviewer thread lineages, a fail-closed provider preflight, a reviewer roster and a review panel; needs PowerShell 5.1 or 7, git, and the Codex CLI signed in to ChatGPT or given a [model_providers] table whose env key the user sets.
